title: Knowledge leaf front matter (PRD §3.2)
description: The YAML front matter of one knowledge leaf file; the markdown body below it holds the actual knowledge content. Truth anchor: the world — citation-anchored, human-gated writes only. One leaf per file, so the front matter is the store file and carries schema-version (§3.5). A leaf may carry an opaque accession id (id: L-NNNNNN), minted at PR time and never reused, alongside its positional notation; the loader indexes by the accession when present and both spellings resolve in cross-references (UCS-1144). Notation is immutable once any reference cites it; moves happen by new leaf + class-elsewhere redirect, never by renaming in place (§3.5). Cross-reference resolution and tree-index consistency are structural-validator checks (KK-05). Schema evolution is additive-only (§3.5, D-013).

id.description: Accession id — opaque, minted at PR time, never reused, never positional (L-NNNNNN). Optional while the store migrates; when present it is the leaf's identity and what the loader indexes by.

notation.description: Positional within the per-project tree (e.g. "362.1"). Quote it — unquoted it parses as a number.

domain.description: LEGACY navigational domain — a free string naming the tree branch this leaf files under, paired with `division` and mirrored in the notation spine (§3.2). Ungoverned: nothing checks it against a vocabulary. Distinct from `facets.domain`, which is the REGISTRY-GOVERNED subject path (UCS-1148) whose every segment must be minted. The two coexist while v2 lands; UCS-1149 settles which survives.

division.description: Legacy navigational subdivision under `domain`, ungoverned in the same way. See the note on `domain`.

notes.description: Governance notes required by the build skill: scope/class-here.

class-elsewhere.description: Redirects — must resolve. Either an accession id or a notation.

see-also.description: Related context — must resolve. Either an accession id or a notation.

including.description: Standing room: candidate topics, not authoritative.

citations.description: REQUIRED — an unsourced claim is not promotable.

facets.description: Governed facets: values drawn from the store's registries (UCS-1148). Membership is a structural-validator check, never a schema enum — the vocabulary is minted by literary warrant under steward review, so it grows by a registry edit plus a Decisions entry rather than by an engine release.

domain.description: Hierarchical domain path from the domains registry, '/'-joined. Valid only when EVERY segment is minted — a child cannot hang off an unminted parent. This is the GOVERNED subject path, not the legacy top-level `domain` free string: membership here is a structural-validator check against knowledge/_registries/domains.yaml, and the top level of that registry is open (a new class is a registry edit plus a Decisions entry).

operations.description: Verbs from the operations registry — what this leaf lets a reader DO.

authority.description: The source's authority tier, from the authority-tiers registry (UCS-1148). A tier is a governed value, not an enum: which tiers a project recognizes is its own to mint.
